caption:
Flip and negate. Doing just one isn't enough.

Perpendicular slope = flip AND negate: 3/4 becomes −4/3. Then 1 = −8 + b, so b = 9.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Perpendicular lines: flip AND negate. Doing just one is a trap.

youtube.title: Perpendicular Lines: The Negative Reciprocal Trap
